opening.argument: The description makes a low-barrier reward conditional on buying or selling at least $100 of digital currency: “Buy or sell $100 of digital currency or more, get $10 of free bitcoin.” It then directs viewers to an external referral URL, while the crypto-oriented title and references to a referral list and business opportunity frame the offer as the promotional subject. The speaker also presents “My business formula, my business strategies, battle tested in life” as part of the discussion. Although the visuals are primarily music and podcast-style cover art, the available evidence does not establish fulfillment, complete terms, or viewer loss.
